Great news that 10/10 is open! But I need to be upfront about the numbers: a Saturday full-day buyout is $3,600, and even our 5-hour weekend minimum runs $1,300 before catering — plus catering at $35–$65/person for 80 guests would push things well beyond $2,400 on its own. That said, let me connect you with our events manager — they may have flexibility I'm not aware of, and can talk through options like a shorter time block. They'll follow up by email today.
